items.b: OURA'S IPO RANGE VALUES A RING MAKER AT UP TO $14.1BN
items.t: The 21 September prospectus offers 50,000,000 shares at $40 to $44, 36,500,000 of them from existing holders. Eli Lilly and Dragoneer have signalled $400.0m of interest.

items.b: GJEPC PUTS FY2025-26 GEM AND JEWELLERY EXPORTS AT US$27.72BN
items.t: The council's 60th annual general meeting, at the Bharat Diamond Bourse on 23 September, also recorded membership at 10,910 and four free trade agreements signed in the year.

items.b: GOLD BACK TO $4,296.60, UP $42.10 ON THURSDAY'S MARK
items.t: Silver gained 1.45% and platinum 0.92% on the Kitco bid at 06:07 ET. London's newest fixes, all dated 24 September, fell on all four metals.

items.b: MASTERCARD FORECASTS 6% US HOLIDAY GROWTH TO 24 DECEMBER
items.t: Online is put at 11% against 3.6% in store, and the company attributes about half the increase to higher prices. Bain's figure for the season is 4.5%.

items.b: BOKO TIES NATURAL-DIAMOND DEMAND TO THE OKAVANGO BASIN
items.t: Botswana's president announced a second phase for Okavango Eternal in New York on 23 September. The partnership began in 2021 on a 10-year term and Botswana holds 15% of De Beers.

items.b: RICHARD MILLE TAKES GB1 TIMEKEEPING FOR THE 38TH AMERICA'S CUP
items.t: The British challenger races the second preliminary regatta at Naples from 24 to 27 September. No financial terms were disclosed.
